title: Synergy Baseball App: Multigame View
description: Master the default Multigame view: pitch and spray charts, data tables, display customization, video playback, duplicating and PDF export.

modules.title: Multigame Overview, Charts and Tables
modules.summary: Pick a player and season, Apply, and get a pitch chart, spray chart and six expandable data tables.
learning_objectives: Read the pitch and spray charts
modules.content:
## What Multigame View is

Multigame is the **default view** and the first navigation icon at the top right. It shows pitch locations and balls-in-play (BIP) results plus basic statistics, based on the data filters you apply. Hover over an icon to see its label.

![Multigame View icon in the top navigation](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565378-01.jpg)

**To generate a report:** pick a player and season in the left filters, then click **Apply**. You get chart and table views, and can play video, customize displays, rename them, add notes, print to PDF, and save.

## The two charts

- **Pitch Chart** (leftmost by default): all pitches thrown, grouped by pitch type, one color per type. You can show/hide the legend or switch to an **efficiency scale** or **zone placement** view.
- **Spray Chart** (rightmost): all contact made against the listed pitchers. Each colored line is a hit type.

![Pitch Chart display options: Type, Zones and Efficiency](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565382-01.jpg)

## The six data tables

Below the charts, expandable and collapsible tables show totals and percentages for your filters:

1. Basic Statistics
2. Pitch Type
3. Pitch Result
4. BIP Type
5. BIP Result
6. Non-BIP Result

Select any row (including the **Overall** row) and click the **Play** icon above the charts to watch that video.

questions.question: Which view is the default when the app opens?
questions.explanation: Multigame is the default and first icon.

questions.question: What do the colors on the Pitch Chart represent?
questions.explanation: Pitches are grouped by pitch type, one color per type.

questions.question: Which is NOT one of the six Multigame tables?
questions.explanation: Stolen Bases is a Reports view report, not a Multigame table.

modules.title: Customizing Displays and Playing Video
modules.summary: Resize, hide, edit and focus your displays, then play single pitches, selections or whole tables.
learning_objectives: Play video for one pitch, a selection or a table row
Know which stats do not play video
modules.content:
## Customizing displays

- **Resize** with the **+** and **-** icons below the pitch chart.
- **Show or hide** the legend and your applied filter selections.

![Display Legend and Display Filter Selection options](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565380-01.jpg)
- **Show one chart**: use the icon above the displays (right of the pitch count and playback icons) to view only the pitch chart or only the spray chart.

![Icons for showing only the pitch chart or spray chart](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565380-02.jpg)
- **Edit Display**: open the drop-down arrow next to the chart options and choose **Edit Display** to change the title and add notes.

## Playing video

Choose Player, Editor or Compare in the upper left first.

![Video playback options: Player, Editor, Compare](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565383-01.jpg)

- **Everything**: click the blue playback icon next to the display title and pitch count.
- **One pitch or event**: click the pitch or spray line, then click **Play**.
- **A selection**: Ctrl-click pitches, contact results or zones, or click and drag across the chart, then click **Play** above the chart.
- **A report row**: click a row (or the **Overall** row) in any table except Basic Statistics.

## Limitation

The **AVG, OBP, SLG and OPS** values in Basic Statistics do **not** play video. To see the related video, use the chart filters on the grey bar to the right of the spray chart.

questions.question: How do you add notes to a Multigame display?
questions.explanation: Edit Display lets you change the title and add notes.

questions.question: How do you play a custom selection of pitches?
options: Ctrl-click or drag across them, then click Play
Only possible in Single Game view
questions.explanation: Ctrl-click or drag to select, then click the Play icon above the chart.

questions.question: Which Basic Statistics values do NOT play video?
questions.explanation: Those are calculated from Synergy data; use chart filters to see related video.

modules.title: Duplicating, Deleting and Saving as PDF
modules.summary: Duplicate a report to compare versions, delete it when done, and export to PDF in four formats.
learning_objectives: Choose the right PDF export option
modules.content:
## Duplicate or delete

Use the drop-down menu next to the icons above the chart display. From it you can choose which charts to view, **edit** the display, **duplicate** the report for side-by-side comparison, or **delete** a report.

## Save as PDF

Open the **PDF menu** (PDF icon above the chart display, next to the change/duplicate/delete options) and pick one of four options:

| Option | What you get |
|---|---|
| **With Data** | Images with data tables, portrait |
| **No Data** | Images only, landscape |
| **All - With Data** | All duplicated images and their data, landscape |
| **All - No Data** | All duplicated images only, landscape |

![The PDF menu with its four export options](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565388-01.jpg)

Then name the report and choose where to save it. PDFs are meant for printing or sharing with your team.

![Naming the PDF before saving](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy-baseball/77000565388-02.jpg)

## Tip

If you built several duplicated displays to compare (for example two pitchers), use an **All** option to capture all of them in one PDF.

questions.question: Which PDF option includes data tables in portrait format?
questions.explanation: With Data is the portrait export that includes tables.

questions.question: Which PDF option captures every duplicated display and its data?
questions.explanation: All - With Data includes all duplicates and their data.

questions.question: Where do you find the duplicate and delete options?
options: Drop-down menu next to the icons above the chart display
questions.explanation: They are in the drop-down next to the chart display icons.
